summary: Full-screen radial blur that eases in with speed. Drop it on the main camera.
overview: A "going fast" radial blur driven by a normalised speed you feed it each frame — typically velocity magnitude over top speed. A camera image effect using OnRenderImage, which is the classic Built-in RP approach.
useCases: Racing games where speed should be felt.

params.tuning: Subtle works. Enough blur to notice consciously is usually enough to induce motion sickness.
Stops the blur snapping on and off with speed changes. Higher reacts faster.

gotchas.title: You must feed it the speed
gotchas.body: It has no idea how fast anything is going. Without a per-frame SetSpeed01 it does nothing.

gotchas.title: Built-in RP only
gotchas.body: OnRenderImage is not how URP or HDRP do post-processing. This project is Built-in RP throughout.
